entries.rationale: Tailwind 3 build dependency. Vulnerable braces execution observed only during trusted production compilation using repository-controlled content globs. No execution in backend, worker, Nginx runtime or inspected browser artifact. Production users cannot control the patterns supplied to braces. Reviewed 2026-10-11 for PR #662: immutable post-CAS closure rounds and effective closure-tooling authentication change only recovery scripts and tests. Frontend source, dependency locks, runtime packaging, and build patterns are unchanged; canonical browser closure and runtime packaging were independently revalidated.
